meta.status: Round 28 Lane N1 proposal, approved by the user on 2026-10-02 and applied to the catalogue data (tools/r28_names/apply.py). `current` is the name before the pass, `proposed` the name now shipped; role and item ids never change.
rules: Signal words (size, age, strength, temperament, wits) appear only on start-zone roles (levels 1-10 in the six start zones) and on T1 items.
In the start zones the signal words form one ladder, the same in all six starts: see `ladder` (column by disposition/kind, rung by the role's first level).
Everywhere else each display name (default and every by_zone variant) belongs to exactly one role, avoids base-mob and rare names, and has at most three words (named leaders excepted).
Siblings (roles of one family that share a zone outside the start band) differ in more than their first word: "Tidepool Crab" and "Reefclaw Snapper", never "Tidepool Crab" and "Reefclaw Crab".
Disposition is shown by the yellow/red name tag, not by the name. Named leaders keep "Title Name".
meta.zones_note: zones = where the catalogue notes and world.md cast tables place the role (capital-band outlaw and undead roles may also appear in selected heartlands). Areas are designed later by the zone lanes.
